holder-quote: I stare at the hand that cast the spell, and for the first time, I see Az’kerash, Perril Chandler, the Necromancer in person.
effect-quote: Thick strands of web fly out and encircle me. Instantly, I’m covered in webs, barely able to move.

holder-quote: At the same time, a stream of grey tendrils lashed out from Typhenous’ staff.
effect-quote: The sticky web from his spell anchored parts of the worm to the ground, impeding its movement.
